docs.title: Welcome to EngLearner API
docs.text: EngLearner is a vocabulary learning application that uses a Fibonacci-based spaced repetition system (SRS) to help learners memorize vocabularies effectively.

docs.title: Core Features
docs.text:
• Fibonacci-based scheduling: Review intervals follow the sequence 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21 days
  • Progress tracking: Track your learning progress through each review cycle
  • Automatic reset: Progress resets to day 1 if you fail to answer correctly

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
1. Set up Supabase credentials in .env
  2. Run the API server: uv run fastapi dev
  3. Access Swagger docs at /docs

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text:
• FastAPI: Modern Python web framework
  • Supabase: Database and authentication
  • Pytest: Testing framework

docs.title: POST /api/v1/vocabularies
docs.text:
Add a vocabulary to the review queue.

Request:

{
  "word": "ephemeral",
  "definition": "lasting for a very short time",
  "example": "The ephemeral beauty of cherry blossoms"
}

Response:

{
  "id": "uuid",
  "word": "ephemeral",
  "definition": "lasting for a very short time",
  "example": "The ephemeral beauty of cherry blossoms",
  "current_day_index": 0,
  "next_review_date": "2026-02-16",
  "status": "reviewing",
  "streak_count": 0
}

docs.title: GET /api/v1/vocabularies
docs.text: Get all vocabularies in the review queue.

docs.title: Authentication
docs.text: EngLearner uses Supabase Auth for user authentication.

docs.title: Flow
docs.text:
1. Sign Up / Sign In: Use Supabase Auth client (or dashboard)
  2. Get Token: Receive JWT access token
  3. API Requests: Include token in Authorization header
Authorization: Bearer <your-jwt-token>

docs.title: Protected Endpoints
docs.text: All vocabulary endpoints require authentication. Include the JWT token in the request header.

docs.title: Token Refresh
docs.text: Tokens expire after a set time. Use the refresh token to get a new access token.
